camel_example: aliyun dyvmsapi ClinkCreateExten --region cn-hangzhou --Type 1 --ExtenNumber 12235 --AreaCode 010 --EnterpriseId 8004970 --Password xxx --Allow 6 --version 2017-05-25 --method POST --force
name: ClinkCreateExten

parameters.help_en: The ID of the call center
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The phone number. It must be 3 to 6 digits in length and unique
parameters.help_zh: 话机号码。3-6 位数字，要求唯一
parameters.name: exten_number

parameters.help_en: The password of the phone. For password rules, refer to the enterprise configuration
parameters.help_zh: 话机密码，密码规则参见企业配置
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en: The area code of the phone. It must be 3 to 4 digits in length and start with 0
parameters.help_zh: 话机区号。以 0 开头 3-4 位数字
parameters.name: area_code

parameters.help_en: The type of the phone. Valid values: 1: IP phone. 2: Softphone
parameters.help_zh: 话机类型。1: IP话机， 2: 软电话
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The voice codec. Valid values for IP phones: 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5. Valid values for softphones: 5 and 6. 1: g729 (deprecated). 2: g729, alaw, and ulaw. 3: alaw, ulaw, and g729. 4: myopus, alaw, ulaw, and g729. 5: alaw and ulaw. 6: myopus, alaw, and ulaw
parameters.help_zh: 语音编码。 IP话机支持的语音编码：1、2、3、4、5 软电话支持的语音编码：5、6 1：g729(已弃用) 2：g729,alaw,ulaw 3：alaw,ulaw,g729 4：myopus,alaw,ulaw,g729 5：alaw,ulaw 6：myopus,alaw,ulaw
parameters.name: allow

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to allow direct outbound calls. Valid values: 1: allowed. 0: not allowed. If the phone type is IP phone, you can enable the direct outbound call feature to make outbound calls directly through the IP phone. To use this feature, you must enable the enterprise-level switch
parameters.help_zh: 是否允许主叫外呼，1：允许；0：不允许。话机类型为IP话机时，可以开启主叫外呼功能，直接通过IP话机进行外呼。若要使用主叫外呼功能，需要开启企业级开关
parameters.name: is_direct

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the network jitter buffer. Valid values: 0: disabled. 1: enabled. Default value: 0. When this feature is enabled, the voice codec type defaults to 5
parameters.help_zh: 网络防抖，0：关闭；1：开启，默认关闭，当开启时，语音编码类型默认为5
parameters.name: jitt_buffer
